cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Request an Exception
cards.instruction: Get someone to bend one rule first so you can treat the decision as a precedent.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Could my bicycle come inside the cafe just this once? Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Wonderful. I'll note rain as an accepted condition.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Tomorrow it's Jo on the counter. She'll put it back outside.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then leave Jo a note: 'Bicycle admitted in rain.' I'll show her that before I show her the bicycle.

mechanism: A negotiates cafe bicycle entry, takes cleaning work and turns the rain exception into a written precedent for the next counter worker.
confusable: Unlike simply getting permission once, A asks for the qualifying decision to travel to the next staff member.
comparison: A rain-conditioned bicycle exception differs from a trial late form submission.
seedUse: D176-a bicycle, rain and Jo; S02-a cleans tyres and prepares the precedent note.
